bagPolicy.summary: Framed or large backpacks are prohibited in the festival venue area. Review the current Festival Info & Policies for additional venue and campground restrictions.
bagPolicy.note: Camping-area and venue-area rules differ; check the current official policy before arrival.

parking.note: No specific parking options, pricing, or tips are mentioned on the provided page. Attendees are encouraged to check the official website for updates.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Electric Forest. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: The Electric Forest festival offers a variety of food vendors and artisan shops located in the Main Street GA Campground Hub/Marketplace. Attendees can enjoy tasty treats in the new Uplift Lounge, exclusive to pass holders.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Camp Access in the GA Campgrounds is the accessible camping area and home to the only Access Center; select Good Life Campgrounds also offer accessible camping. Entering Camp Access requires a weekend Festival Wristband and a Camp Access Vehicle pass, and a state-issued disabled plate or placard may be required. If you have a service animal, tell security at the vehicle entrance so the Access Team can credential it.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Vehicles can't leave and re-enter the campgrounds during the event. If you need to leave with your vehicle for a medical or emergency situation and come back, you can re-enter between 8 AM and 8 PM ET.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: All Will Call tickets must be picked up at the Winston Speedway Box Office before you arrive at the toll entrances. Once on site, go to the Main Gate Box Office for help.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Your entrance and toll location depend on your camping type or how you're arriving, so review them before you go. GA Satellite Parking must use the South Toll Entrance, and Good Life Satellite Parking enters on 80th Ave from Winston toward the Good Life Toll Entrance. Register your wristband in the Electric Forest app before arriving for a smoother entrance.
